scope: Navigation speed selection trained through G1 MuJoCo outcomes; not base locomotion retraining.
limits: Synthetic actors; pedestrian 0.55 m center envelope, moving car rectangular envelope, pothole keep-out zone without terrain deformation. No physical robot trial.
weatherScope: Rain changes contact friction and track visibility; fog limits tracking range. No fluid, camera-perception or hydrodynamic simulation. Condition labels are not policy inputs.
